reason: Frozen A3 bullet 1: the improver (environment-generating adversary) and the evaluated product (protagonist policy) are both RL-updated weights. Generated environments are transient per-episode samples of the adversary policy; nothing non-weight is retained, gated or re-read (no environment population/archive). Distinguished from POET (cal-h1-v2, in scope) whose retained, feedback-gated environment population is itself evaluated; the paper itself names that population as the distinction (opus/O01).

signatures.object: Environment-parameter policy (adversary) generating maze layouts / MuJoCo disturbance forces; protagonist and antagonist navigation policies
signatures.information: Adversary sees fully observed grid state, timestep and a noise vector; reward = antagonist best return minus protagonist mean return (regret). Protagonist/antagonist see partial 5x5 views.
signatures.operation: Three-player RL game: adversary proposes environment, antagonist (allied) and protagonist play it, all updated by PPO
signatures.output: Updated adversary/antagonist/protagonist weights; protagonist policy evaluated zero-shot on hand-designed mazes
signatures.conditions: Underspecified environment with free parameters; solvable-by-construction via antagonist; Theorem 2 needs adversary-antagonist coordination
signatures.feedback: Return difference between two learning agents in same generated environment
signatures.selection_rule: None beyond RL objective; no archive or acceptance gate for generated environments
signatures.persistence: Policy weights only; generated environments are not stored or reused
signatures.later_use: Protagonist deployed zero-shot; not applicable to a harness-component retention loop
signatures.claimed_effect: Higher path length solved and 40%/18% Labyrinth/Maze success vs 10%/0% (minimax) and 0% (DR), author-reported
signatures.failure_boundary: Non-coordinating antagonist variants degrade (App E.1); regret signal noisy

gap.author_gap: Domain randomization cannot tailor difficulty to the learner and minimax adversaries generate unsolvable environments.
gap.checked_gap: Real limitation of prior environment-design methods within RL (cited: POET, asymmetric self-play, Campero et al.); not a harness-level gap.
gap.lineage: domain randomization / minimax adversarial RL -> POET and teacher-student curricula -> PAIRED (minimax regret via antagonist)
gap.closest_adjacent: POET (population minimax), asymmetric self-play, Campero et al. teacher; compared experimentally only to DR, minimax and PBT-minimax baselines
gap.residue: Unsolvable or trivial environments; no learning-progress-adaptive difficulty
gap.stakes: Zero-shot transfer and emergent complexity of RL policies
gap.method_response: Regret objective via allied antagonist keeps environments difficult but feasible
gap.remaining_gap: Equilibrium guarantee needs coordination; noisy regret; small navigation and hopper domains
unresolved: Gap analysis not completed beyond scope check because paper is excluded

claims.text: PAIRED (adversary trained on protagonist-vs-antagonist regret) produces a curriculum of increasingly complex solvable environments and yields RL policies with higher zero-shot transfer than domain randomization or minimax adversarial training.
claims.setting: RL navigation (15x15 MiniGrid-like) and MuJoCo hopper, PPO, 5 seeds
claims.baseline_control: Domain randomization, minimax adversary, PBT minimax
claims.selection_vs_test: Hyperparameters chosen on validation environments for transfer; test mazes held out (App F.1.2)
claims.result_denominator: 10 trials x 5 seeds per transfer env (Fig 3 caption)
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported RL-policy transfer; no harness-component conclusion

evidence.quote: We train policies by starting with an initially random policy, generating environments based on that policy to best suit its continued learning, train that policy in the generated environments, and repeat until the policy converges or we run out of resources.
evidence.support_explanation: 被改进/评测的主产物为训练后的策略权重，而非留存 harness。

evidence.quote: The adversary and antagonist are trained to maximize the regret as computed in Eq.
evidence.support_explanation: 课程产生器及求解器通过学习参数更新。

evidence.quote: In the Labyrinth (Maze) environment, PAIRED agents are able to solve the task in 40% (18%) of trials.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告训练策略的零样本迁移；不是非权重留存收益。

evidence.quote: We tested a limited number of hyperparameter settings on a set of validation environments, consisting of a different maze and labyrinth, mazes with 5 blocks and 40 blocks, and a nine rooms environment.
evidence.support_explanation: 调参/测试分开，但不足以改变评测对象的范围。

evidence.quote: Though multi-agent learning may not always converge
evidence.support_explanation: 明示对抗训练不保证收敛。

evidence.quote: To generate structured, solvable environments for our protagonist agent, we introduce a second, antagonist agent that is allied with the environment-generating adversary
evidence.support_explanation: Three learned agents (protagonist, antagonist, environment adversary) make up the method.

evidence.quote: All agents are trained with PPO
evidence.support_explanation: Every learned component (protagonist, antagonist, adversary) is updated by PPO gradient updates, i.e. weights.

evidence.quote: We then test the trained policies in a set of challenging transfer tasks not provided during training.
evidence.support_explanation: The evaluated product is the trained RL policy; generated environments are transient training distributions, not retained artifacts.

evidence.quote: PAIRED agents achieve higher zero-shot transfer performance when tested in highly novel environments.
evidence.support_explanation: The central claim is about policy (weight) transfer, not a non-weight harness component.

evidence.quote: In the Labyrinth (Maze) environment, PAIRED agents are able to solve the task in 40% (18%) of trials.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported transfer result of the trained policy (5 seeds, 10 trials each per Fig 3 caption); context only, not scored.

evidence.quote: the main algorithmic distinction between POET and minimax environment design is maintaining a population of environment adversaries and agents that are periodically swapped with each other
evidence.support_explanation: Authors: POET's retained population is what PAIRED lacks; PAIRED keeps no non-weight environment store, which is the A3 distinction from the in-scope POET ruling.
